inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The printed decision tree: Gram ⊕ → Bacilli (aerobic: Listeria, Bacillus, Corynebacterium; anaerobic: Clostridium, Cutibacterium; branching filaments: Nocardia [weakly acid fast] vs Actinomyces [not acid fast]) and Cocci → catalase ⊝ Streptococcus (pairs or chains) vs catalase ⊕ Staphylococcus (clusters); hemolysis α (optochin sensitiVity and bile solubility → S pneumoniae [encapsulated] vs viridans [no capsule: S mutans, S mitis]); β (bacitracin sensitiVity and PYR status → Group A S pyogenes vs Group B S agalactiae); staphylococci by coagulase (S aureus vs S epidermidis/S saprophyticus) with NoVobiocin sensitiVity; GroWth in 6.5% NaCl and PYR Status → Enterococcus (E faecium, E faecalis) vs Nonenterococcus (S gallolyticus).
